svg.title: K4 — Shuttle mat (overview)
svg.text: K4 — Shuttle mat: the membrane cell
A roller-blind mat runs from a cassette over a small table to a bar on an arm: it cuts, rolls, carries and drops food, and is washed as it is wound back.
induction coils, turntable motors, load cells
every hob position is a turntable
dry drive room 90 · gallery 60 with the arm links
mat 400 wide: K ivory, S red
Mat K drawn out of its cassette
Mat S drawn out, mince docked
1/9 Bar B takes the hem of mat K at the gate mouth and draws the mat out of its cassette, up through the gate, over the table.
2/9 The box docks at the left wall and tilts about its pour edge: carrots slide out lengthwise onto the mat.
3/9 SHUTTLE + CHOP: bar B winds the mat in steps, the blade arm chops on the soft anvil strip after every step.
4/9 SLING + NOSE: arm B carries the mat out over pot P3, then winds in: the slices are pulled off the nose into the pot.
5/9 Mat K goes home: its reel winds it back through the wash gate (rinse, detergent, 85 °C rinse, squeegee).
6/9 Bar B fetches mat S (silicone, raw meat); arm C brings the pan to P4; mince is docked onto the mat.
7/9 LOOP: bar B comes close to the table edge, the slack mat hangs as a trough between the cheeks and rolls the mince to a log.
8/9 The log is cross-cut under the disc-knife roller, then SLING + NOSE lays the patties into the pan on P4.
9/9 Mat S is wound back through the gate with steam: washed and disinfected while it is retracted.
